explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/114 (the EHP lemniscate length conjecture): for every n ≥ 1 and every monic p of degree n, the 1-dimensional Hausdorff measure of {|p| = 1} is at most that of {|z^n - 1| = 1}. Excluding n = 0 is correctly justified. It remains open for small n, so the open status for the all-n statement is right.
